_comment: triage-v5 deterministic classification rules. Extends frozen rules-v1..v4 (all retained untouched). Stdlib-only classifier: tools/triage/classify.py --rules rules-v5.json. New inputs (frozen, committed): knowledgegraph/triage/xrefs-2540f2ca.tsv (223704 edges), xrefs-2540f2ca.externals.tsv (362 dests), sdk-boundary-repairs-2540f2ca.json (1186 adjudications), queue-2540f2ca.json (207 rows). v5 changes, each load-bearing: (1) SDK contained-alias policy - repaired-contained/prologue VAs map onto the existing containing function (no speculative function creation; 88 multi-name targets resolved by majority-namespace then lexicographic-min, losers recorded as aliases; 36 targets already sdk-named keep their canonical name); (2) vtable-family ownership propagation for the 5755 FUN_ vtable pool (union-find over vtables.json pair-clusters + inheritance chains + dispatch edges; game-namespace family with >=2 distinct SDK slot funcs -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC INFERRED; engine-namespace families keep ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION with subsystem fill; anonymous families stay UNKNOWN debt); (3) priority quirk fix - sdk+vtable-without-decomp rows move P3->P1 (structural slot link outranks missing decomp file; the 315 sdk+decomp-no-vtable P3 rows stay P3, unchanged from v3/v4); (4) at-scale middleware identification - CRT/STL via MSVCR90 import ancestry + mangled names, RenderWare via vtable families, DirectX/EASTL absence documented; per-row machine-readable rationale throughout. Subsystem map: v4 map carried over; family label may fill 'Unknown' for vtable members. Category order (first match wins): 1) third-party (thunk/external/section/name, v4 regexes) -> THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME; 2) v5 CRT-wrapper rescue (UNKNOWN-only: MSVCR90 import calls, zero internal callees) -> THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME INFERRED; 3) sdk engine-ns -> ENGINE_INTERFACE; 4) sdk game-ns + vtable -> GAMEPLAY (v3 rescue); 5) v5 vtable-family game-ns -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC; 6) vtable slot -> ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION; 7) singleton -> GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT; 8) named game-ns -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC; 9) else UNKNOWN. v5 outputs get a NEW snapshot hash (v5 inputs included) and NEVER overwrite 2540f2ca artifacts; no DB writes by default (ingest is the next worker's step).

v5_alias_policy.resolution: target already sdk-named -> keep canonical, record alias note; else majority top-namespace (ties: lexicographically smallest namespace), then lexicographically smallest full name within that namespace; all other distinct names recorded as aliases on the row

verdicts_ignored.adjudicated-tail-alias: alias inside containing function; no row change

v5_vtable_family.labeling: per candidate: class = middle component of SDK slot names (ns::Class::Method, incl. ctor/dtor Class::Class); candidate label = dominant class; union-find over vtables.json clusters (shared-slot pairs) + inheritance_chains (base/derived) merges candidates into families; family label = dominant class across the component; dispatch (vtable-ref) edges add metadata only (callers never classify a row alone)
v5_vtable_family.game_ns_families: vtable member + family ns in game_namespaces + family has >= min_distinct_sdk_funcs distinct SDK slot functions -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC INFERRED
v5_vtable_family.engine_ns_families: keep v4 ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION; subsystem filled from family label
v5_vtable_family.anonymous_families: no SDK slots -> stay v4 ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION/UNKNOWN debt, no attribution

crt_stl.wrapper_rule: UNKNOWN-only: calls >=1 MSVCR90.DLL import and zero internal call callees -> THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME INFERRED (crt-wrapper)

v5_middleware.renderware: named RenderWare::* rows + vtable families with RenderWare SDK slots -> subsystem RenderWare
v5_middleware.directx: D3D/IDirect regexes kept; zero D3D-named functions and zero d3dx9/D3DX imports found in the 362 external dests -> documented absent (GOG build links RenderWare, not D3D9)
v5_middleware.eastl: zero ea::/EASTL symbols in functions/sdk/strings exports -> documented absent

v5_priority_fix.quirk: v4: sdk+vtable+NO decomp fell to P3 (bool(sdk) XOR (vtable|decomp) false, P2 needs non-sdk). v5: any vtable member with sdk_name is at least P1 (P0 when decomp present). The 315 sdk+decomp-no-vtable P3 rows stay P3 (v3/v4 deliberate: no structural slot link).
v5_priority_fix.p1: (sdk AND vtable) OR (v4 P1 set: sdk-only-no-decomp, vtable-only-FUN_-no-decomp, decomp-only)

v5_queue.preserve: all 207 v4 queue rows keep rank, queue_state, and db mapping (implemented Cell rows untouched)
v5_queue.promotion: v5 rows newly GAMEPLAY_LOGIC with family evidence (>= min_distinct_sdk_funcs distinct SDK slot funcs of the family class) and not already queued -> appended as candidate (state=candidate), ranked by family distinct-SDK-func count desc then va; ambiguous/anonymous rows stay UNKNOWN debt, never queued
v5_queue.no_wall_clock: projections carry no timestamp (byte-identical rerun requirement)

notes.category_order: 1) thunk/external/non-.text/third-party-name -> THIRD_PARTY; 2) v5 CRT-wrapper (UNKNOWN-only, msvcrt-import-only) -> THIRD_PARTY INFERRED; 3) sdk engine-ns -> ENGINE_INTERFACE; 4) sdk game-ns + vtable -> GAMEPLAY; 5) v5 vtable-family game-ns (>=2 distinct SDK slot funcs) -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC INFERRED; 6) vtable slot -> ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION; 7) singleton -> GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT; 8) named game-ns -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC; 9) else UNKNOWN. Alias layer runs before category: contained-alias sdk_name assignment (see v5_alias_policy).
notes.snapshot: v5 snapshot_sha256 = sha256 over (v4 five input file bytes + decomp name list, exactly as v4) + sha256 of the four v5 inputs + sorted VA list. Deliberately different from 2540f2ca; 2540f2ca artifacts are never rewritten.
notes.db: v5 run writes projections only (no spore.db triage upsert by default; --db to opt in). DB ingest with classifier_version triage-v5 is the next worker's step; the triage table's classifier_version column already distinguishes versions, and kg.py user_version migration must be checked against the v4 convention before ingest.
notes.no_incremental_mode: Same as v4: full reclassification of all 58757 functions every run; byte-identical projections for identical inputs.
